What happens to my Netflix when I die?

By the Afterkeep research team · Reviewed on 9 Nov 2026

Short answer: Netflix keeps charging the payment method on file until the membership is cancelled; nothing happens automatically when a member dies. Netflix says it can cancel the account of a friend or family member who has died. With access to the account, use Cancel Membership on the Account page. Without access, contact Netflix with the email address or phone number on the account and the full payment information currently used to pay for it.

Key facts

  • Netflix will cancel on behalf of someone who has died
  • No login needed: give the account email or phone and payment details
  • Signing out or deleting the app doesn't cancel
  • Partner-billed memberships are cancelled through the partner

How do I prepare my Netflix account?

  1. Note in your digital estate plan which email address or phone number your Netflix account uses and how it's paid. That's what family will need to cancel it.
  2. After a death, with access to the account: go to the Account page, select Cancel Membership, then Finish Cancellation. Netflix emails a confirmation to the account's email address.
  3. If needed, use Sign out of all devices so the account isn't left logged in on TVs and phones.
  4. Without access: gather the email address or phone number on the Netflix account and the full payment information currently used to pay for it, then contact Netflix through help.netflix.com.
  5. If there's no cancel option on the Account page, the membership is billed through a payment partner (for example a phone, internet or TV package). Netflix says it must then be cancelled with that partner, and the Account page shows how.
  6. Check the next card or bank statement to confirm the Netflix charges have stopped.

Read the official policy ↗

What documents do heirs need?

  • The email address or phone number associated with the Netflix account
  • The full payment information currently used to pay for Netflix

How long does it take?

Netflix publishes no processing time for cancelling on someone's behalf. After cancellation the account won't be charged again, and if there's time left in the billing period it stays usable until it cancels automatically at the end of that period.

What can't be recovered?

  • Streaming for everyone using the account's profiles once the membership ends
  • Any remaining gift card or promotional balance is used for continued service after cancelling, until it runs out

Frequently asked questions

What happens to my Netflix when I die?

Netflix keeps charging the payment method on file until the membership is cancelled; nothing happens automatically when a member dies. Netflix says it can cancel the account of a friend or family member who has died. With access to the account, use Cancel Membership on the Account page. Without access, contact Netflix with the email address or phone number on the account and the full payment information currently used to pay for it.

What happens to my Netflix account when I die?

Nothing automatic. The membership keeps billing the payment method on file until someone cancels it. Netflix says family or friends can ask it to cancel the account of a member who has died.

How do I cancel a deceased person's Netflix without the password?

Contact Netflix with the email address or phone number associated with the account and the full payment information currently used to pay for Netflix. Netflix says it can then cancel the account on their behalf.

Does signing out or deleting the Netflix app cancel the account?

No. Netflix says cancelling from the account is the only way to end the membership; signing out or deleting the app doesn't cancel it.

What if Netflix is billed through a phone or internet provider?

Netflix says memberships billed through a payment partner must be cancelled with that partner. The Account page's Membership section shows a link or instructions.

When do Netflix charges stop after cancelling?

Netflix won't charge again after cancellation. If there's time left in the billing period, the account can be used until it cancels automatically at the end of that period.
